text: The cosmic microwave background was released at recombination, when neutral hydrogen formed at T ≈ 3000 K, corresponding to a redshift of z ≈ ___.
explanation: At z ≈ 1100 (t ≈ 380,000 yr, T ≈ 3000 K) the universe cooled enough for protons and electrons to combine into neutral hydrogen, so photons decoupled and free-streamed to form the CMB. At that moment the universe was about 1/1101 of its present size. This last-scattering surface is what we observe today as the CMB.
